Hi Ben / Maya - thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery call:

- Constraints: PCI-adjacent data handling, on-prem options preferred for certain workloads.
- Stakeholders to include: Security (Maya), Procurement, Platform/Infra

Next steps:
1) Product demo (30m) - high level walkthrough of Redwood capabilities.
2) Technical deep dive (60m) - SE + infra: quantization, batching, KV cache, deployment options (Dedicated vs Private).
Would you be available for one of these slots next week?
- Tue Aug 25, 10:00-11:00 PT - technical deep dive

If neither works, share a couple of options and I'll confirm.

I'll loop in our Security lead (Vivek) and our SE (Rafael) for the technical session. Attached: discovery-notes-20260818.txt (notes), draft demo agenda (redwood-demo-agenda.pdf).
